items.name: b11985
items.body:
<details open>

metal : faster MXFP4 mat-vec, full threadgroups for unary/binary/GLU (#31075)

* metal : faster MXFP4 mat-vec kernel

Decode the fp4 values with the fp16 bit trick instead of a threadgroup lookup table, and load the packed nibbles as aligned 32-bit words. The kernel no longer uses threadgroup memory.

* metal : launch contiguous unary and binary ops with full threadgroups

The contiguous unary path and the row-broadcast binary path used one thread per threadgroup. Use up to 256 threads per threadgroup and bound-check the tail.

* metal : split GLU rows across threadgroups

A GLU row ran on one threadgroup, so single-row decode used a single threadgroup for the whole op. Split each row over threadgroups of up to 256 threads.

</details>

items.name: v5.22.0: Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk)
items.body: ## New Models ### Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk) Mistral Large 4 is Mistral's largest and most capable model to date: a 1 trillion-parameter natively multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model with 49 billion active parameters per token (52 billion including embeddings and output layers), trained from scratch on 3,800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs in Mistral's own datacenters in Europe. Mistral Large 4 unifies instruction following, reasoning, coding, and agentic workflows in a single set of weights. While a generalist model, it shows especially good performance on workloads such as cybersecurity, finance, and law, and it surpasses frontier closed models on visual grounding. It is natively fluent in 160+ languages, including every official language of the European Union. #### Key Features Mistral Large 4 includes the following architectural choices: - **~1T total / ~52B active parameters**: granular Mixture-of-Experts with 128 routed experts (4 active per token) and 1 shared expert. - **1M context length**, for long-context workloads. - **Multimodal input**: accepts text and image input, with text output. Pixtral-style vision encoder trained to handle variable image sizes and aspect ratios. - **Instruct and Reasoning functionalities** with function calls, reasoning effort configurable per request. Mistral Large 4 offers the following capabilities: - **Reasoning Mode**: three reasoning efforts — `low`, `medium`, `high` (default) — so the same model can answer a quick chat reply or work through a complex agentic run. - **Vision**: analyzes images, charts, technical drawings, and documents, with state-of-the-art visual grounding among open weights
